newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel flat, LS holds around $126.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel flat, LS holds around $126.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil remained subdued after price falls late last week.
Dealers said levels of $125 and $126 fob NWE remain fair market value despite a pickup in gasoline and some support from cracked low sulphur which gained $1 on swaps.

"There is still some length but the worst may be over," said a refiner. Meanwhile, Russian exports appeared to be picking up, with about three E-4 cargoes on offer and poorer quality M-100 asking $114 cif Rotterdam. Dealers said the E-4 cargoes were likely to get picked off by refiners eager to maximise gas oil production.
